title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Bettina Roux (6:05 P.M.)
Hi. I think I left my tortoiseshell sunglasses at your salon when I came in this afternoon. I probably left them on the reception counter while I was paying.

Ravi Sandhu (6:07 P.M.)
Hello, Bettina. This is Ravi from Copperleaf Hair. Let me look in our lost property and see whether they were handed in. Please hold on.

Ravi Sandhu (6:11 P.M.)
Good news. We do have your sunglasses here. They weren’t on the counter, though. One of the stylists found them on the chair by the front window.

Bettina Roux (6:12 P.M.)
Oh, what a relief. I’ll come in tomorrow to pick them up. Would it be all right if I called in at about half past eight? I finish work late.

Ravi Sandhu (6:13 P.M.)
That’s no trouble at all. We stay open until ten on Fridays, so there will be someone here to help you.
